title: kbtools.py prints the catalog of the kb's tools and the few that answer a need, read from each tool's Answers: and Use: docstring lines and the skills', agents' and MCP tools' descriptions
goal: each _tools command-line tool's module docstring ends with Answers: lines (the questions it answers, in plain words), a Use: line (its command) and an MCP: line when a kb MCP tool runs it, read with ast and never imported; kbtools.py with no argument prints the catalog (one line each: tool, command, what it answers) of those tools, the skills and agents by their frontmatter descriptions and the kb MCP tools by their descriptions; kbtools.py NEED [--json] prints the best entries for NEED by word match, deterministic; selfdoc.py check fails a command-line tool with no Answers: or Use: line, naming it; kbmon's kb panel counts the cataloged tools and those missing their lines
